title: THE OILY BASALT OF YWEEN // THE JUNGLE EXPEDITION
narrative: Deep in the suffocating green canopy of Sothoryos, where bloodflies hummed in poisonous clouds, an expedition of Braavosi adventurers stumbled upon the ancient ruins of Yween. The city was built of colossal blocks of oily, light-absorbing black basalt, so massive that no human hands could have lifted them. Strange, cyclopean carvings depicted tentacled gods devouring feathered serpents before the dawn of humanity. In the center of the basalt plaza stood an idol whose black stone felt greasy and warm to the touch, humming with vibrations that induced sudden, violent nosebleeds in the living.
